title: Human acceptance recipe — triage of one or more runs
description: Written by the agent after reading a run. Every failed or blocked expectation is classified and decided before it becomes a fix, and every passed writing step gets its read-only confirmation. The gate reads this file; an unclassified failure keeps it red.

class.description: product: the screen differs from what the code was meant to render. recipe: the screen is right, the expectation described it wrongly. data: the witness is no longer in the assumed state. undecided: no note — ask the tester, never guess (keeps the gate red).

evidence.description: What establishes the class: code path, query result, screenshot reference.

decidedBy.description: Required for accept-risk: who took the risk.

fixRef.description: Story, task or commit that carries the fix.

replayIn.description: Recipe id where this step is played again.

writeChecks.description: One entry per step with writes: true that the tester passed. A tick is an observation; this is the proof.

evidence.description: Read-only result: row timestamp, event, response.
